field.name: issueOps
field.purpose: Groups the issue operations that tracker-auto, the bugfix path and questions.ts need beyond the sketch (create returning the native id and typed flag, sub-issue link, close, comment, body read and write, label, milestone ensure and attach), all available under the issue-create capability. The sketch methods are unchanged.

body.rationale: The HLD gives s1 the extraction of the tracker-auto issue calls and the bugfix create and close calls behind the port, and the sc1 sketch has no close, comment, body, label, milestone or sub-issue operation. One additive field keeps the sketch methods unchanged for s4, s5 and s7.
